name: zclass_world_add_light
description: zClass_World::AddLight appends a light node/data pair to a world and records the reverse attached-world link.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this world/light list helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x451360 validates realloc-backed append of the light node/data arrays, world light-count increment, reverse attached-world append, and zero return.

The native smoke verifies AddLight appends the light node and light data to world storage, updates the world light count, adds the world to the light's attached-world list, and pairs with RemoveLight cleanup.
